name: Robo-Run 2027 (Shaastra, IIT Madras)
source: Shaastra Robo-Run 2027 Description and Rules (8 pages); main event 6 Jan 2027, SAC, IIT Madras

start.square: fully black, in one of the four corners
start.startLine: between the start square and the second square
start.timerStarts: front edge of the bot crosses the start line

finish.timerStops: front edge of the bot enters the destination square
finish.location: at the end of the maze track; one pathway; a simple line follower cannot easily find it

session.officialTime: minimum valid time score over the session

checkpoints.nonFinisherScore: (actual run time + penalties) / C, C = value of the furthest checkpoint covered (nearest the destination)
checkpoints.notes: Locations and values are told at the start of the match. Loop case: after 3 loops the bot may be put at the nearest checkpoint (penalties apply). Assumed here: 3 checkpoints on the shortest route at 25 %, 50 %, 75 %, values 1, 2, 3.

finalRound.placement: on yellow squares at dead ends
finalRound.cleared: pushed completely off the yellow square; the square then becomes a checkpoint
finalRound.notes: Not simulated yet (needs block-pushing physics and a colour sensor).

operator.notes: Operator behaviour is not in the rulebook: how long it takes to place and fetch the bot, and when an operator gives up on a run. Estimates; edit to match your team.
